Package com.mobybank.harness.application

package com.mobybank.harness.application
The use cases. Each *ApplicationService loads an aggregate, changes it, saves it, and publishes what happened; none of them contains business rules (those are in the domain) or knows about HTTP.
  • SessionApplicationService: start a conversation, send a message, attach an upload, move a session. Agent turns and moves run in the background.
  • FolderApplicationService: browse the folder library, connect folders, list the documents of connected folders.
  • CurrentUserApplicationService: who the sidebar shows.

The services speak in commands and DTOs (*Command, *DTO), which use only strings, numbers and other DTOs, so the REST layer never touches a domain type. SessionEvent lists what a client can be told as it happens.

Three small ports belong here rather than in the domain because only the application needs them: BackgroundRunner, SessionEventStream and UploadStore.
